messages:
maria: Heads-up - I'm testing preflight telemetry for /embeddings. Saw a spike of 413s when mixed dims + big arrays. Need a plan for metrics + dashboard before we roll preflight on by default.

aj: Which spike? sample?

maria: last hour on canary tenant 'search-proto'. Quick sample: 82 requests with `dim_mismatch=true` flagged, 60 of those ended 413. Not huge but noisy. Can't tell if client-side or splitter.

devon: We should add counters: `embeds.preflight.requests`, `embeds.preflight.rejects`, labels: `tenant, route, dim_count, payload_bytes, reason`.

sasha: +1 labels. Also histogram for latency of preflight check itself `embeds.preflight.latency_ms` buckets 1,5,10,50,200.

luis: For console: show rate and reject-rate per-tenant and top offending clients. Add quick link to failed payload example. Maybe a heatmap for dim distribution.

maria: Also thinking sampling of failed payloads (store base64 or redacted) at 1% to investigate without PII risk.

aj: How about rollout? Start with opt-in preflight flag on console, default off for 1 week, then opt-out via per-tenant toggle. Need telemetry before enabling globally.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary preflight-check v1 deployed to `embeds-splitter-canary` at 2026-03-20T14:10Z :rocket:

devon: We need queries for metrics team. Proposed PromQL for reject rate:
```
sum by(tenant) (rate(embeds_preflight_rejects_total[5m]))
/
sum by(tenant) (rate(embeds_preflight_requests_total[5m]))
```

sasha: For console panel: put a small sparkline in tenant row and link to details page with top 10 fingerprints.

maria: Edgecase: mixed-dim requests that split into multiple batches — preflight might accept but downstream splitter still 413s. We'll add `split_result` label values: `ok`, `partial_split`, `hard_fail`.

luis: Telemetry retention: keep raw failure samples 30d for canary tenants, 7d for prod, aggregated metrics 90d.

aj: Security: redact text inputs, store only lengths, hashes, dims. Need ops sign-off.

maria: I'll draft RFC with metric names, dashboard mock and rollout plan. Will ping infra-telemetry and console for UX mock.

sasha: If you want quick UX, I'll mock a tenant-row toggle + details flyout by EOD :+1:

maria: Thanks — setting up a short sync at 16:00 to align.
